# mtncloud_plan (Data Source)

Master tenant only: customer (sub-tenant) logins get 403 from the API it uses. Looks up a service plan by name. Customers: use `mtncloud_plans`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_plan" "vmware" {
  name = "1 CPU, 4GB Memory"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provision_type` (String) The name of the service plan provisiong type (i.e. - Amazon EC2, Azure, Google, Nutanix, VMware, etc.)

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud plan.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Optional code for use with policies
- `description` (String) The description of the plan
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
